test_title: PYST 30 - SSC CHSL 2025 - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 24 Nov, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: A sum is being lent at 10 percent per annum compound interest (compounding annually). What is the ratio of amount at the end of first year to the amount at the end of second year?
solution:
**Given:**

Rate of interest = 10% per annum

Compounding = Annually

**Formula Used:**

Amount at the end of n years = Principal × (1 + Rate/100)ⁿ

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let Principal = P

⇒ Amount at the end of the first year = P × (1 + 10/100)

⇒ Amount at the end of the first year = P × 1.1

⇒ Amount at the end of the second year = P × (1 + 10/100)²

⇒ Amount at the end of the second year = P × 1.1 × 1.1

⇒ Amount at the end of the second year = P × 1.21

⇒ Ratio of amount at the end of the first year to the amount at the end of the second year = (P × 1.1) : (P × 1.21)

⇒ Ratio = 1.1 : 1.21

⇒ Ratio = 10 : 11

**∴ The correct answer is 10:11.**
